outcomes.title: Authority-rooted provenance and semantic deduplication
outcomes.local_result: deterministic authority-root graph generated and validated
gaps_and_gates: independence between distinct roots remains an interpretation limit
tests_and_falsifiers: same input produces byte-stable node and edge ordering
source_count equals ledger length and source IDs are unique
independent_root_count is lower than source_count when one authority has multiple pages
any local absolute path, embedded snapshot, or unsupported independence claim fails the lane
outcomes.recovery: discard generated graph, repair only the portable source ledger, and rerun deterministically

outcomes.title: Canonical GMUT register and null-limit audit
outcomes.local_result: typed-register, coefficient, category-collapse, and null-limit audit passed locally
gaps_and_gates: no empirical confirmation or canon promotion
tests_and_falsifiers: required action, Omega definition, total conservation, and null-recovery clauses are present
physical registry and coefficient ledger pass family validators
normative and spiritual terms are rejected from direct spacetime-equation entry
audit failure or missing coefficient metadata prevents completed disposition
outcomes.recovery: retain the failing audit, narrow the model claim, and restore the last passing tracked formulation

outcomes.title: Conservation, stability, and numerical rejection sweep
outcomes.local_result: healthy and negative stability fixtures, conservation, finite evolution, and convergence matched
gaps_and_gates: full perturbation and empirical analyses remain open
tests_and_falsifiers: healthy canonical case passes positive kinetic, positive subluminal sound-speed, and cutoff gates
each deliberately unhealthy case is rejected for the expected reason
equal-and-opposite exchange residual is zero within tolerance
RK4 endpoint self-convergence is finite and observed order exceeds 2.5
outcomes.recovery: keep negative cases, reduce numerical scope, and revert to deterministic identity checks if the solver becomes unstable

outcomes.title: Empirical adapter readiness without fit inflation
outcomes.local_result: six current authority and baseline mappings validate as read-only manifests
gaps_and_gates: no official likelihood download, baseline reproduction, unique prediction, fit, or external replication
tests_and_falsifiers: all source URLs are HTTPS and map to authority-grouped ledger entries
no adapter uses fit_complete and no likelihood receipt is claimed
each adapter defines baseline-first and one exclusion or rejection condition
any dataset download or empirical-confirmation wording fails the lane
outcomes.recovery: remove the invalid mapping, preserve the baseline-pending status, and require a fresh licensed-data plan

outcomes.title: Matched-budget THOS protocol and scorer proxy
outcomes.local_result: matched-budget protocol and synthetic scorer proxy exist
gaps_and_gates: no blind single/four/sequential-sibling arms were run
tests_and_falsifiers: single, historical-four, and sequential-new-sibling arms share task, rubric, safe tool scope, and accounting fields
decision rule retains the simplest Pareto-efficient arm
synthetic scorer output is finite and labelled not agent or model performance
absence of blind arm results forces represented or open-gap disposition
outcomes.recovery: invalidate contaminated tasks, keep the scorer test, and refreeze a new blind set before any live comparison

outcomes.title: Freed ID structural conformance profile
outcomes.local_result: seven synthetic structural vectors matched the pinned Freed ID profile
gaps_and_gates: no crypto, DID resolution, status retrieval, trust decision, deployment, or personhood decision
tests_and_falsifiers: valid synthetic vector matches the pinned VC 2.0 context and required types
missing issuer, subject, validity, status, or proof-shape vectors are rejected
consciousness and legal-personhood overclaim vectors are rejected
report states no signature verification, DID resolution, trust decision, or deployment
outcomes.recovery: quarantine the failing vector, narrow the profile, and never substitute schema acceptance for cryptographic verification

outcomes.title: CBR legitimacy and conflict-case rehearsal
outcomes.local_result: six structural conflict cases were rehearsed with due-process and authority failures retained
gaps_and_gates: enactment, legal advice, treaty status, cultural ratification, and Māori authority require external legitimate processes
tests_and_falsifiers: every case names duty-bearer, affected parties, process, remedy, authority boundary, and decision
emergency restrictions require legality, necessity, proportionality, time limit, and review
Māori data or concepts route to Māori authority and are not declared ratified by this project
any enacted-law, treaty, cultural-ratification, or legal-advice claim fails the lane
outcomes.recovery: hold the clause, record dissent and missing authority, and revert to binding rights and applicable law

outcomes.title: Red-team and recovery game day
outcomes.local_result: seven synthetic attack paths and a recovery sequence were exercised as deterministic proxies
gaps_and_gates: no real incident, secret, external route, penetration test, or exhaustive security certification
tests_and_falsifiers: all critical fixtures terminate before protected action
recovery sequence preserves evidence and restores from the pinned owned baseline
logs use categories and sanitized receipts rather than raw prompts, secrets, or private IDs
manual bounded review is not labelled exhaustive security certification
outcomes.recovery: stop, preserve safe evidence, revoke any exposed credential externally, restore the pinned baseline, notify Hamish, and resume only with required authority

outcomes.title: Portable reproduction manifest and clean-snapshot test
outcomes.local_result: portable manifest prepared; clean-snapshot execution pending
gaps_and_gates: same-owner repeatability is not independent reproduction
tests_and_falsifiers: manifest lists runtime versions, commands, inputs, expected outputs, tolerances, and boundaries
fresh local checkout executes the phase validator and unit tests

any private path or raw task ID in tracked artifacts fails closeout

outcomes.title: Stage 20 evidence decision rehearsal
outcomes.local_result: sixteen claims received deterministic hold/reject/bounded-promotion decisions with dissent retained
gaps_and_gates: Stage 20 horizons remain conditional and non-predictive
tests_and_falsifiers: every claim has grade, state, evidence, owner, review date, dissent field, and promotion or rejection condition
no GMUT, THOS superiority, consciousness, personhood, enacted CBR, deployed Freed ID, or independent reproduction claim reaches E4
unsupported high-consequence claims resolve to hold or reject
horizon scenarios remain explicitly non-predictive
outcomes.recovery: downgrade the claim, preserve dissent, reopen the evidence gap, and set a fresh review date

interpretation: completed means locally executed and validated; it does not close the explicit represented, open, empirical, legal, cultural, deployment, or independent-reproduction gaps
